newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia to auction land next to holy city of Mecca worth around two billion riyals.
- Al-Rajhi Banking and Investment posts 1.2 billion riyal net profit in 1996.
- Kuwait's 1995/96 budget deficit decreased to $2.035 billion from earlier forecast of $5.365 billion.
- Bahrain to host a joint conference between Gulf Arab and Japanese businessmen on March 23.
